maddeler.e:
نلتحق (form VIII)
# نَلْتَحِقُ (naltaḥiqu) /nal.ta.ħi.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# نُلْتَحَقُ (nultaḥaqu) /nul.ta.ħa.qu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# نَلْتَحِقَ (naltaḥiqa) /nal.ta.ħi.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# نُلْتَحَقَ (nultaḥaqa) /nul.ta.ħa.qa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
